titleSq: Tokë në shitje në Llukar, Prishtinë
titleEn: Land for sale in Llukar, Prishtina
descriptionSq: Ofrohet per shitje truall me siperfaqe 10 ari, me lokacion ne Llukar, Prishtine.
Trualli ka infrastrukture te plote, qasje ne rruge, ujesjelles, kanalizim, si dhe lidhje me energji elektrike.
I pajisur me flete poseduese dhe kontrata behet tek noteri.
Trualli ndodhet ne nje zone me qarkullim te larte, ideale per veprimtari te ndryshme.
descriptionEn: A plot of 10 ares is offered for sale, located in Llukar, Prishtina.
The plot has full infrastructure, road access, water supply, sewerage, as well as a connection to electricity.
It comes with an ownership certificate and the contract is signed at the notary.
The plot is located in an area with high traffic, ideal for various activities.
